description: Injection-recovery completeness of the deployed search at the jackknife detection tier, as a function of injected white-noise S/N
snr_definition: 0.85 * depth * sqrt(in-transit points) / point scatter, point scatter = 1.4826 * MAD(diff(flux)) / sqrt(2) (scripts/injection_recovery.py)
source: 140 batman injections into 20 calibration-split QLP light curves (known planet masked), periods log-uniform 0.7-12 d, 5 search passes; tallied with the jackknife score
